resources.string: Allow this app to draw over Battle Cats, then come back and start the helper.
The paw is on. Tap it to read the screen, hold it to switch modes, drag it to the bottom to stop.
Tap Start helper, then pick Entire screen and press Start now in Android\'s prompt. That is one approval per session — after it the paw stays on top of the game until you stop it.
Tap on a stage to read its name and list the enemies that will appear.
Tap on a cat to read its name and level, then see its stats at that level.
Hold the bubble for half a second to switch — the icon and the colour change with it, so you always know which mode is on.
Huge shoutout to Godfat and the OG dataminers - this piece of dark magic wouldn\'t exist without them.

⚡ This solver runs 100% offline on your own device at godspeed: zero queues, zero waiting on anyone ahead of you. Whether you consider this a quality-of-life miracle or pure dark magic cheating... use it at your own discretion!
